---
title: "🜔 The Ladder of Ascent"
---

Seven rungs separate the Initiate from the Hierophant. Points accumulate. Titles transmute.

## 🜂 How Points Accrue

Three sources contribute to your ascent:

- **Defeated creatures** — see [the Bestiary](bestiary.qmd). Most weekly work hits a named, pre-priced creature.
- **Hidden Sigils** — see [Minor Mysteries](sigils.qmd). Bonus rewards bestowed for discipline beyond the pattern.
- **Wild encounters** — work outside the Bestiary, judged in the moment by the master who assigns them.

When your point total crosses a threshold, you transmute. The new title is bestowed by your master in the review of the Pull Request that triggered the crossing — you do not claim it yourself.

## 🜁 The Seven Levels

| Level | Title                              | Threshold |
|-------|------------------------------------|-----------|
| I     | Initiate                           | 0         |
| II    | Acolyte of the Calx                | 75        |
| III   | Apprentice of the Crucible         | 200       |
| IV    | Journeyman of the Athanor          | 400       |
| V     | Adept of the Aludel                | 650       |
| VI    | Magister of the Vessel             | 950       |
| VII   | Hierophant of the Quintessence     | 1300+     |

Levels IV, V, and VI carry sealed gifts — see [§V on the Codex](../index.qmd#v-the-path-of-ascent).

## 🜃 Notes for the Apprentice

- Levels are status, not gates. All knowledge in the Forbidden Library is open at every level. The Forbidden Classes are the only thing actually sealed by progression.
- A slow week still earns. A fast week can leap past a milestone.
- Your title is *bestowed*, not *claimed*. Update only `points_total` in your `progress.md`; leave `title` for the master to change.
